search_audit.outcome: Searched and inspected both Commons description pages and their exact Original file links. The pages establish the labeled script styles, record associations, and CC0 statements. Direct image fetch attempts returned cache misses; no pixels were inspected.

gaps: Previously failed oracle image candidate kou_oracle_alt_commons_redraw and its exact image URL were excluded. Xiaoxuetang query returned HTTP 401 with no candidates. The two inspected Commons alternatives have exact direct URLs established from their file pages, but direct fetches returned cache misses; the harness must determine whether these can be acquired. No physical artifact image was visually inspected.

items.caption: Modern vector redraw of a 口 form associated with a late Shang bronze vessel; it illustrates an early bronze-script rendering, not the inscribed artifact itself.
items.alt: Modern vector outline of the character 口 in Shang bronze script style.
items.selection_reason: An alternate to the unavailable oracle redraw, with a file description associating it with a named late Shang vessel and Xiaoxuetang record 31.E4A8.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 as stated on the Commons file page; the Sinica-derived image is identified there as CC0. This candidate is a modern vector rendering.

limitations.text: The web tool could not fetch either exact SVG URL because of cache misses, so pixels were not visually inspected. No visual claims beyond the file-page labels and provenance are made; whether the harness can download them remains unverified.

Neither the underlying Xiaoxuetang character-specific image record nor a physical inscription was independently opened in this pass. The Commons pages provide the record identifiers and claimed associations.
